scope: Five asynchronous cases on a 3000-step run (whole-domain images), a windowed capture run, and describe/sequence replays of the saved frames, 2026-10-20.
notes: Solver and callback code changed since 23089bb: asynchronous path, describe and sequence modes, plot window, end_time_s in the state.
The llama-server process is the one started on 2026-10-11; a short trial of the same suite an hour earlier left the system prompts in its cache (cached token counts are in the records).
log.PODFoam.gz and telemetry.jsonl.gz are gzip -9 -n copies of the originals; the hashes are of the compressed files.
ground_truth.private.json means withheld from model input, not private personal information.
